about: Gestation of 26 weeks on 14 July supports pregnancy at both the May Panadeine Forte supply and the July Endone supply.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about "Pregnancy on the opioid supply date being reviewed". Panadeine Forte (codeine) in April 2026 and Tramal (tramadol) in June 2026 are supplied to a 29-year-old woman.
Opioids were last supplied in September 2025, months before the pregnancy recorded in February 2026. Paracetamol is the only analgesic supplied during the recorded pregnancy.
